XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Running engine shutdown with hard restart, immobilizer light and oil level warning light on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P1671 | P0191 | P0190 | REGULATOR | PRESSURE | FUEL | DIESEL | DIESEL FUEL | STARTS | ON | MIL | RED | RED LIGHT | SWITCHES OFF | STOPS | LOCK | STALLS | MOVEMENT | ROAD | JOURNEY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Fuel pressure regulator

  • Fault: Sudden engine stalling with the engine fault light coming on. After restarting, the engine stalls again after a short distance. Subsequently, the engine struggles to start and starting is only possible after several attempts or after a certain amount of time.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
  • P1671 (Fuel pressure regulator - Fault)
  • P0191 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Incorrect setpoint)
  • P0190 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Generic fault)
  • Cause: Faulty fuel pressure regulator

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure regulator and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The regulator is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, secured to the high-pressure fuel pump; it is accessible from the top of the engine.

    The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 0.4 hours.
